requirement.description: The build_netlist function fails when processing tuples in IR representation. Tests like SwitchTestCase::test_print, SwitchTestCase::test_comb, SwitchTestCase::test_sync, etc. are failing because they encounter tuple objects that don't have the expected 'items' attribute, suggesting an issue with how IR representations are being processed in the netlist building process.
requirement.contract: Modify the build_netlist function in amaranth/hdl/_ir.py to properly handle tuple representations of IR constructs, ensuring that all IR objects can be converted to netlist format without AttributeError when accessing 'items' attribute.

requirement.description: The netlist building process fails with TypeError when converting certain IR objects to Amaranth values. Specifically, tests like RhsTestCase::test_arrayproxy and RhsTestCase::test_switchvalue are failing due to conversion errors.
requirement.contract: Update the netlist conversion logic in amaranth/hdl/_ir.py to properly handle type conversions for IR objects that currently raise TypeError when attempting to convert to Amaranth values.

requirement.description: Memory-related tests are failing due to incorrect error message formatting. Tests like MemoryTestCase::test_init_wrong_count, WritePortTestCase::test_signature_wrong, and WritePortTestCase::test_constructor_wrong have mismatched error messages, indicating improper error message formatting or validation.
requirement.contract: Fix error message formatting in amaranth/lib/memory.py to ensure consistent error message format matching the expected test assertions.

requirement.description: Operator and format-related tests are failing due to assertion mismatches and incorrect handling of value castable formats. Tests like FormatTestCase::test_construct_valuecastable, OperatorTestCase::test_matches_enum, and OperatorTestCase::test_abs are failing due to incorrect assertion expectations or value casting issues.
requirement.contract: Correct the value casting and format handling logic in amaranth/hdl/_ast.py to properly handle value castable objects and produce correct assertions for format and operator tests.

requirement.description: RTLIL backend tests are failing with various errors including missing module imports and incomplete output generation. Tests like RHSTestCase::test_operator_eq, RHSTestCase::test_operator_add_imm, and SwitchTestCase::test_simple are failing due to incomplete or incorrect RTLIL generation.
requirement.contract: Fix the RTLIL backend conversion logic in amaranth/back/rtlil.py to correctly generate RTLIL output for all test cases, including proper handling of operators and switch statements.
